brand.name: GreyVault
brand.tagline: Pre-owned Rolex, Audemars Piguet and Patek Philippe, inspected on 47th Street.
brand.description: An independent New York dealer of authenticated pre-owned watches. Every piece opened, measured and documented by a watchmaker before it is listed.

contact.directions: Between Fifth and Sixth Avenue, north side. Enter the exchange and ask the lobby desk for Booth 12. Bring a photo ID.

policies.insuredShipping: Free insured overnight shipping in the US. FedEx Priority, signature required, fully insured door to door.
policies.international: International shipping on request, insured, duties paid by the buyer.

payments.name: Bank wire
payments.note: Preferred. No fee. Released on receipt of funds.

payments.name: Certified check or cash
payments.note: In person at the booth. Cash subject to federal reporting.

payments.name: Credit card
payments.note: Up to $15,000 per watch. 3% processing fee.

payments.name: Financing
payments.note: 6 to 24 month plans through a licensed lending partner, subject to approval. Demo partner shown.

payments.name: Trade-in
payments.note: Put a watch you own toward any piece. We quote within one business day.

team.name: Daniel Hakimi
team.bio: Grew up on the street working his father's booth. Buys every watch personally and answers the WhatsApp line most evenings.

team.name: Maya Rosen
team.bio: WOSTEP-trained. Opens, measures and signs off on every piece before it is listed. Writes the condition reports.

team.name: Sam Okafor
team.bio: Handles sourcing requests, trade-ins and appointments. Ask him for anything not on the site.

team.name: Elena Petrova
team.bio: Runs paperwork, insurance and shipping. Every parcel leaves with her checklist.

items.quote: Maya walked me through the timegrapher readout before I paid. No pressure, no games.
items.author: J. Alvarez

items.quote: Traded my Datejust toward a Royal Oak. Fair number, done in one visit.
items.author: R. Chen

items.quote: Bought sight unseen from Chicago. The condition report matched the watch exactly.
items.author: M. Brooks
